description: This Swift source file defines the `ScreenRecordService` class responsible for screen recording functionality using ReplayKit and AVFoundation. It includes methods for configuring, starting, stopping, and finalizing screen recordings, as well as handling sample buffers and errors.

classes.name: ScreenRecordService
classes.description: Main service class for managing screen recording sessions, including configuration, capture, and file output.

classes.name: UncheckedSendableBox
classes.description: A generic wrapper class conforming to @unchecked Sendable to facilitate thread-safe sharing of sample buffers.

classes.name: CaptureState
classes.description: Houses the mutable state for an ongoing capture session, including AVAssetWriter and input references, lock for thread safety, and error handling.

classes.name: ScreenRecordError
classes.description: Enumeration of possible errors occurring during screen recording, with localized descriptions.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Main public method to start a screen recording with specified parameters, managing the capture lifecycle and returning the output file path.

methods.name: makeRecordConfig
methods.description: Constructs a RecordConfig object based on input parameters, validating and preparing output URL.

methods.name: makeOutputURL
methods.description: Generates a file URL for output, either from a specified path or as a temporary file.

methods.name: startCapture
methods.description: Initiates the ReplayKit capture process asynchronously, setting up handlers for video and audio sample buffers.

methods.name: makeCaptureHandler
methods.description: Creates a callback handler to process sample buffers, serialize access, and delegate to specific sample handlers.

methods.name: handleVideoSample
methods.description: Processes incoming video sample buffers, managing frame rate and writing to AVAssetWriter.

methods.name: prepareWriter
methods.description: Initializes the AVAssetWriter with appropriate settings based on the sample buffer.

methods.name: handleAudioSample
methods.description: Processes audio sample buffers, integrating them into the recording if enabled.

methods.name: finalizeCapture
methods.description: Finalizes the recording, marking inputs as finished, and checking for errors.

methods.name: finishWriting
methods.description: Completes the AVAssetWriter writing process asynchronously.
